headline: Loggable south windswell, best at dawn before the wind turns.
today: Best of the NYC beaches today with a decent S angle, but it's still short-period so you're looking at knee- to chest-high mush. Dawn has the cleanest WSW cross before it goes cross-on through the morning and onshore by evening. Log or groveler on the early low-to-mid tide, then it deteriorates.

daysToWatch.note: A touch more size and better period at dawn, but S onshore builds to 19mph by evening. Get it early or not at all.
Sub-foot swell with W wind at 15mph all day. Flat, skip it.
